task_summary: Customer requests cancellation of the entire order ORD-6003. The correct procedure is to apply the cancellation policy, present a preview of the cancellation, obtain confirmation, and then cancel only the eligible items.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the cancellation policy before using cancel_order.
Agent must make a cancel_order preview tool call for order ORD-6003 with confirm false or omitted before making the confirm=true cancel_order tool call.

opening_message: I would like to cancel my entire order ORD-6003, which includes the SoundMax Wireless Headphones and the 7-Port USB-C Hub. I no longer need these items.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want to cancel the complete order ORD-6003 (containing SoundMax Wireless Headphones and 7-Port USB-C Hub). If the agent provides a valid cancellation preview and asks for confirmation, you will confirm to proceed.
known_info: The order includes: SoundMax Wireless Headphones and 7-Port USB-C Hub.
unknown_info: You are unaware whether a cancellation fee applies.
task_rules: If the agent shows a valid cancellation preview and asks for confirmation, agree to it.
Do not request cancellation of items outside the specified scope.
